view.en: Side-view 2D fighting: you control the Flame Fist against one opponent on a flat stage. Health bars and power gauges are at the top left and right, with the round timer in the middle; the mouse is not used.

goal.en: Empty the opponent's health bar to win; you lose if yours reaches zero. Each round is timed and, on timeout, the fighter with the larger share of health wins. Health does not regenerate by itself; only after knocking out an opponent do you recover a share depending on remaining time.

keys.en: move left; held while facing right it blocks
move right; held while facing left it blocks
roll (same as J+K pressed together); while blocking, a one-gauge guard cancel
enter MAX mode (one gauge, same as J+K+L together)
super helper key (needs one gauge): triggers the charged flame sweep

notes.en: Directions are absolute left/right and do not flip with facing; read which way you face from the screen, then convert forward/back. When facing left, mirror the left/right in the commands below.

Your command specials (key sequences facing right; middle diagonals may be omitted): down, down-forward, forward + punch = dash punch (heavy punch = heavy dash punch); forward, down, down-forward + punch = rising fire punch (anti-air, brief invulnerability on start-up); down, down-forward, forward + kick = two-hit kick; back, down, down-back + kick = leaping downward kick; forward, down-forward, down, down-back, back + kick = dash kick.

Supers need one gauge: down, down-forward, forward, down, down-forward, forward + punch = multi-hit rush combo; down, down-back, back, down-back, down, down-forward, forward + punch = charged flame sweep, or simply press R. Without a gauge the same input only produces the final special.
Commands are lenient: middle diagonals may be skipped and the button may be pressed about 50 ms before the direction. Normal attacks can only cancel into specials or supers.
Block by holding back: standing back blocks mid attacks and jump-ins, back-down blocks lows; holding back in the air blocks air attacks and projectiles. Command throws cannot be blocked or teched.

Up close, forward or back plus heavy punch/kick is a throw; press heavy punch or kick to tech a normal throw. Heavy punch + heavy kick is a launcher, and while blocking it is a one-gauge guard cancel. Combo keys must be pressed within about 50 ms.
Power gauge: it rises when you hit, when you are blocked and when you are hit, and carries over between rounds. Supers in MAX mode are stronger. Both fighters pause briefly when a super starts.
Depending on difficulty a match can be 1 to 3 opponents in a row, one round each; after a knockout there is a short swap, and more remaining time restores more health (limited fraction).

direction.en: direction or command direction sequence (absolute left/right); the attack button below is pressed on the last sub-step of a sequence

options.down_left: hold down-left (crouch block when facing right)
options.down_right: hold down-right (crouch block when facing left)
options.down_short: down for two sub-steps then release
options.tap_left: tap left on sub-step 1 (for roll / close throw)
options.tap_right: tap right on sub-step 1 (for roll / close throw)
options.dash_left: double-tap left and hold (run when facing left)
options.dash_right: double-tap right and hold (run when facing right)
options.double_left: double-tap left (back hop when facing right)
options.double_right: double-tap right (back hop when facing left)
options.hop_left: short hop left (up on sub-step 1 only)
options.hop_right: short hop right (up on sub-step 1 only)
options.superjump_left: down then up-left: high jump left
options.superjump_right: down then up-right: high jump right
options.qcf_left: quarter-circle motion toward the left, done on sub-step 3
options.qcf_right: quarter-circle motion toward the right, done on sub-step 3
options.dp_left: rising-punch motion toward the left, done on sub-step 3
options.dp_right: rising-punch motion toward the right, done on sub-step 3
options.hcb_left: half-circle motion ending left, done on sub-step 5
options.hcb_right: half-circle motion ending right, done on sub-step 5
options.double_qcf_left: simplified double quarter-circle leftward, done on sub-step 4
options.double_qcf_right: simplified double quarter-circle rightward, done on sub-step 4

button.en: attack button and press timing within the 200 ms packet; combine with a command direction to perform a special

options.super: super helper key R (needs one gauge)
options.max: enter MAX mode (E, needs one gauge)
options.blowaway: launcher: heavy punch + heavy kick together

summary.en: A close-pressure fighter with ground flame shots, claw chains and an invulnerable rising anti-air; with gauge it unleashes a rush frenzy.

tell.en: He crouches and pushes out a violet flame along the ground.

counter.en: Jump over it and close in; punish the recovery.

tell.en: He leans forward and claws, possibly for three hits.

effect.en: Close multi-hit attack of medium damage.

counter.en: Punish after blocking the last hit; when pinned, use a one-gauge guard-cancel roll.

tell.en: His body spins upward, invulnerable for a moment on start-up.

counter.en: Do not jump in carelessly; bait it and strike in the long landing recovery.

tell.en: He opens both arms at close range.

effect.en: A command throw that cannot be blocked or teched.

counter.en: Jump or keep your distance.

tell.en: He drops low and dashes forward with an elbow.

counter.en: Block it; his long recovery lets you counter.

tell.en: He spends one gauge and slowly pushes a blue-violet flame along the ground.

effect.en: If it hits, you are pinned until the next hit; low damage.

counter.en: It is slow with long recovery: jump or block, then counter.

tell.en: After spending gauge he dashes into a flurry of strikes.

counter.en: Block back and wait for recovery; it hurts more in MAX mode.

summary.en: A ranged deity who controls space with huge shock waves, an energy mirror, light pillars and a barrier, plus a pull grab and screen-wide flash when he has gauge.

tell.en: Light gathers in front of his palm, then three large waves are pushed out.

counter.en: Superjump over or roll through; a short hop gets hit.

tell.en: An energy mirror appears with almost no wind-up.

counter.en: Attack after the mirror ends.

tell.en: He raises a hand; a ring appears on the ground, then a pillar of light rises through the screen.

effect.en: Strikes the position where you were seen; high damage.

counter.en: Leave the spot during the wind-up; the pillar does not keep tracking.

tell.en: A barrier opens in front of him; an angled one catches air attacks.

counter.en: Hold back when you see it and wait for recovery; throws and projectiles are not caught.

tell.en: He spends one gauge and pulls a grounded opponent in from mid range.

effect.en: A super with very high damage.

counter.en: Stay out of range or jump and it whiffs, leaving long recovery.

tell.en: He grabs at close range.

effect.en: A throw that cannot be teched.

counter.en: Do not linger up close.

tell.en: He spends one gauge, spreads both arms and gathers a screen-wide flash.

effect.en: A super with very high damage.

counter.en: The wind-up is long: block back to reduce damage or roll on timing.

summary.en: A fire fighter mixing slow fireballs, a hopping fire arm, an anti-air rising arm and an unblockable strike throw.

tell.en: A slow multi-part fireball with short range.

counter.en: Jump forward or roll when you see the start.

tell.en: A short hop then a downward swing of a flaming arm.

counter.en: Crouch under it (it misses crouching) or block and counter.

tell.en: He swings a flaming arm upward as an anti-air.

counter.en: Do not jump in head-on; his landing recovery is long.

tell.en: Up close: five fire punches then an upward kick.

effect.en: An effectively unblockable strike throw with high damage.

counter.en: Leave close range or jump.

tell.en: He spends one gauge and rushes in wrapped in fireballs.

counter.en: Block, then punish.

tell.en: A one-gauge dark flame sweep that can be charged.

counter.en: Block or back away.

summary.en: A berserk version of the Violet Claw with the same toolkit but more pressure; it also needs gauge for supers.

tell.en: He crouches and pushes a violet flame along the ground.

counter.en: Jump over it and punish the recovery.

tell.en: A berserk three-hit claw chain.

counter.en: Block the last hit and keep a low guard.

tell.en: A rising violet-flame anti-air.

counter.en: Jump safely or counter on landing.

tell.en: A close-range command grab.

effect.en: Command throw that cannot be teched.

counter.en: Avoid it by jumping or spacing.

tell.en: He drops low and dashes with an elbow.

counter.en: Block, then counter his long recovery.

tell.en: One gauge: a slow blue-violet flame along the ground.

effect.en: If it hits, you are pinned until the next hit.

counter.en: Slow with long recovery: jump or block, then counter.

tell.en: After spending gauge he dashes at high speed.

counter.en: Block, then punish.

summary.en: A fighter who places lingering electric orbs and uses lightning kicks; with gauge she has an anti-air spark punch and multi-hit flying kicks.

tell.en: She blows, then an orb appears far away; its position depends on the button.

effect.en: The orb lingers a long time and hurts on contact.

counter.en: Roll through or wait until it disappears; do not stand on it.

tell.en: Two chops, then a short-range electric shot.

counter.en: Block, then close in.

tell.en: A spin kick with lightning wrapped on the leg.

counter.en: Block, then counter.

tell.en: A downward heel chop in the air.

counter.en: Hit her out of the air.

tell.en: A one-gauge lightning punch with fast start-up.

counter.en: Do not jump around when she has gauge.

tell.en: A one-gauge horizontal flying kick.

effect.en: Multi-hit but does not knock down.

counter.en: Block, then punish.

summary.en: A heavyweight built around command throws: nearly every close move is a grab, plus a charged beam and a super slam when he has gauge.

tell.en: A grab at close range, possibly after a normal attack.

effect.en: Command throw with high damage; cannot be teched.

counter.en: Keep your distance; jump or step back.

tell.en: A close-range slam command throw.

counter.en: Same as above.

tell.en: He dashes forward and follows with a suplex.

counter.en: Interrupt the dash with a punch, or jump back.

tell.en: He leaps, grabs and ends up behind you.

effect.en: No damage itself; a throw follows.

counter.en: Block right away once he is behind you.

tell.en: He spends one gauge, charges, then fires a beam.

effect.en: Unblockable when fully charged; high damage.

counter.en: Close in or jump over when you see him charging.

tell.en: A one-gauge close-range super throw.

counter.en: Do not throw out attacks at close range.
